tagline: Room for a giant breed to stretch out full length, back against a bolster.
lead: Your dog can lie full length along the bed with their back against a bolster, instead of curling up in the middle.
value: On a heavy dog, one thin layer of foam is not much between them and the floor. Beech has two, in a 20cm-deep bed.
intro: Beech is an XXL memory foam bolster dog bed, 132 × 104 × 20cm, with memory foam paired with an egg-crate layer, bolsters on three sides, an open front, a fleece sleeping surface and linen-effect side panels.
points: 132 × 104cm, so a genuinely large dog can lie full length.
Memory foam for contour, with egg-crate foam underneath for support.
Somewhere to lean, and nothing to climb over.
Soft where it matters, tidy where it shows.
best_for: Giant breeds and big dogs who sleep stretched out rather than curled up, and like a bolster at their back.
fit_note: One size. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm, then measure the space in the room. Not sure? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Follow the sewn-in care label on the cover. Air-dry it fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.
seo_title: Giant Dog Bed, 132cm XXL Memory Foam Bolster | Snoozly
seo_description: A giant dog bed with room to stretch out full length: 132 × 104 × 20cm, memory foam over egg-crate foam, three bolsters and an open front. Fleece top.
